reviewIssueAdditions.finding: owner-record-has-no-description-field; closure: Native capability owner publishes an admitted description text member (or a registry-bound description record) with provenance; report catalog carries it verbatim.

no-owned-statistic-definition; closure: Either no statistics are shown (current state satisfies the conditional requirement) or an owned statistic over explicitly included history is defined and carried with its history scope.

existing-owner-design-gap: unit membership is owned natively but no graph query carrier exposes importer package membership; closure: Query owner publishes a reviewed coupling projection (importer symbol -> owning workspace/package unit from retained UnitMembershipV1) with counts and completeness disclosure.
no-selected-redaction-owner-for-report-disclosure; closure: Security owner selects a redaction projection for declared configuration inputs; the report carries only that redacted projection.

existing-owner-design-gap: entry points are produced natively but not retained in the Run nor carried by a query; closure: Native and identity owners retain FrameworkRecognitionV1 entry points with the Run; the query owner admits them as path starts with recognition evidence.

owner-record-carries-references-only; closure: Repair/contribution owner publishes an admitted recipe descriptor record (component manifest successor; current manifest schemas are CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED).
no-recipe-selector-parameter-catalogue; closure: Repair owner publishes the recipe selector/parameter catalogue record bound to the admitted recipe closure.
owner-record-has-no-description-field; closure: Policy/contribution owner publishes admitted rule description text with provenance (Rule successor or contribution manifest successor).
no-registered-metric-relation; closure: Native/foundation owners register metric relations with exact subject identity and completeness semantics.
no-owned-test-reachability-fact; closure: Workflow/native owners define a test-reachability fact or projection with identity, completeness and import provenance.

existing-owner-carrier-field-absent: invocation:3 Attempt has no observed duration; no owned timing observation carrier was found; closure: Workflow owner adds an operational observed-duration member to Attempt (host monotonic observation, excluded from Run identity) in an invocation successor.

existing read interface without typed item carrier or html command selector; closure: Query owner types the run.show item record and the command owner adds an explicit Run-id selector for html commands; the report history policy gains an explicit-run-ids source.
